title: Job, Business and Income Information Required by HDB for Housing Loan Applications
what_it_is: Job, Business and Income Information Required by HDB for Housing Loan Applications

sections.label: HDB flat eligibility income assessment
sections.summary: Applicants for an HFE letter are assessed on 12 months' average monthly income, providing CPF history and tax notice, with self-employed persons also giving credit and bank records.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: The assessment is carried out when the applicant applies for an HDB Flat Eligibility (HFE) letter and is based on the applicant’s average monthly income over a period of 12 months.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: All applicants, regardless of the nature of their employment, are required to provide their CPF contribution history and latest Notice of Assessment for income tax, through Myinfo.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Unlike employed persons who generally receive monthly CPF contributions from work that can be used to pay mortgage instalments, self-employed persons typically pay their mortgage instalments fully in cash.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Hence, they are required to provide their Credit Bureau Report and bank statements for an assessment of their financial position and their ability to pay their mortgage instalments every month.

sections.label: Income assessment for mortgage payments
sections.summary: Income assessment criteria check that flat buyers can service monthly mortgage payments, and Members should flag cases needing flexibility to HDB.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: The underlying principle is to make sure that whoever is buying a flat, applying for HDB flat, can service the monthly mortgage payments.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: That is why, there is an income assessment criteria, looking at eligibility of the different incomes – the details are on HDB's website – what form of income will be considered, the IRAS statements and the CPF contributions.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: So, if the Member comes across cases where the applicant requires certain flexibility or case-by-case review, please flag them to HDB and we will take a look.
